title: A Soft Grey
content:
The sky turned a soft grey,
And clouds began to weep,
washing the dust away,
While the world was asleep.

title: Roof Taps
content:
Tap, tap, upon the roof,
A rhythm old and new.
Nature's own little proof,
Of life returning to you.

title: Puddle Mirrors
content:
Reflections in the street,
A world upside down.
Where two realities meet,
In the center of town.

title: Green Drink
content:
The leaves are thirsty now,
They open up their veins.
To catch the drops, somehow,
And wash away their stains.

title: Window pane
content:
Racing drops on glass,
A track that no one sees.
Watching the moments pass,
Moving with the breeze.

title: After the Storm
content:
The smell of petrichor,
Rising from the ground.
Who could ask for more,
Than peace that is found?
